装逼.definition:
动词，通过语言，动作或者神态来惹怒对方或者周围的人 英文翻译 [Troll]
名词，吹牛逼的近义词，不同的是装逼一般是搞笑，不是正经八百的吹牛逼 英文对应翻译 [Trolling]
装逼.example:
【篮球场上】
小明: 丫信不信我把那个黑人扣了
小刚：别装逼，人家快两米，你扣了他我叫你爸爸

装逼.definition:
Firstly it is a verb.

The meaning is someone show off pompously and stupidly, while in fact he isn't cool at all. "装逼" can be used to mockery facetiously or abuse [unfriendly].
"装" /zhuang/means pretend, "逼"/bi/ means female's [genitalia]. When a Chinese character is [followed] by "逼"，the "逼" means awesome, it can be a noun or a adj.
装逼.example:
1、带我装逼带我飞 meaning: If you are [awesome], take me with you to 装逼 [together].
2、少他妈装逼 meaning: Don't [fucking] 装逼.
